description: Updates the values of multiple entity properties for an object, up to 50 updates per request. This operation is for use by Connect apps during app migration.

parameters.description: The type indicating the object that contains the entity properties.
parameters.name: entityType

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description: Returned if the request is not valid.

403.description: Returned if the authorisation credentials are incorrect or missing.
